moves.text: | `IndBallL2` | Projects at any nonnegative scalar step, including zero and infinity. A negative or NaN step throws before writes, including through scalar `Scaled`. A NaN entry gives value NaN at any radius. Zero radius projects to positive zeros. Infinite radius copies the input, and the value is zero if the input has no NaN. At positive finite radius, a single infinite entry gives the signed radius at that coordinate and zeros elsewhere. Multiple infinite entries or any NaN give an all-NaN projection. |
moves.destination_text: | `IndBallL2` | Projects at any nonnegative scalar step, including zero and infinity. A negative or NaN step throws before writes, including through scalar `Scaled`. A NaN entry gives value NaN at any radius. Zero radius projects to positive zeros. Infinite radius copies the input, and the value is zero if the input has no NaN. At positive finite radius, a single infinite entry gives the signed radius at that coordinate and zeros elsewhere. Multiple infinite entries or any NaN give an all-NaN projection. |

moves.text:
For `IndBallL2`, the value and projection compare the norm with the radius in
scaled units when the ordinary sum of squares overflows or is too small.
The domain has no fixed feasibility tolerance. Within the rounding error of
the norm, the comparison can fall on either side of the boundary.
`value_and_prox!` evaluates the stored point. For dense vectors of four
entries with matching `Float32` or `Float64` input, output and radius, the
projection checks the rounded coefficients when the input sum of squares is
ordinary and the finite radius is at least
`2sqrt(4floatmin(T) / eps(T))`. If the rounded coefficients fail the
comparison, it scales them once more toward zero. The stored point in that
case passes the same norm comparison. Other projections can return a stored
point outside the computed boundary, giving `Inf` in the fused call.
A positive finite radius projects a NaN input to an all-NaN output,
including implicit zeros of a `SparseIterate`.
